name: sharded_kv_no_lost_keys-s60-r1
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only 'sharded_kv_no_lost_keys' --skip 'search' 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set|cone|td|houdini|engine|ic3|undecided|pool|filter)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-300 | tail -c 60000; tail -c 2000 /tmp/err.log | grep -iE 'error|throw' | tail -5; echo BROKEN_EXIT=$s; if [ "$s" = 0 ] || [ "$s" = 124 ] || [ "$s" = 137 ]; then exit 0; else exit "$s"; fi
